Hi I'm Gabby, an equine bodyworker in Central Florida and the founder of Victory Equine Services. I am nationally certified in equine massage through NBCAAM and specialize in connective tissue (fascia) bodywork. My biggest goal is to help horses and their owners find victory through health and wellness. 

I can't wait to share my journey to becoming an equine bodyworker! I hope to encourage and educate both horse owners and equestrians considering a career in equine bodywork.
